profile.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER
profile.body: Constantly seeking new projects and ideas to drive innovation. A Computer Engineering student at Universidade Federal da Bahia (UFBA), driven by a passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning and development.

about.paragraph1: Computer Engineering student at UFBA with experience in Go, TypeScript, Java, Python, and C#. I specialize in developing scalable and distributed systems, focusing on microservices (gRPC, Protobuf, Kubernetes, Docker) and integrating MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.
about.paragraph2: I have experience in building e-commerce platforms, process automation (RPA), and developing internal business solutions.
about.paragraph3: I also work with AWS and GCP infrastructure while following AGILE methodologies (Scrum/Kanban). Passionate about technology and innovation, always striving to enhance my skills and apply the best software engineering practices.

timeline.title: A timeline of my trajectory
timeline.subtitle: Want to know more about how I built my experience so far? Here are some projects that have shaped my journey.

titan.title: Backend Development Manager
titan.description: Leads backend project execution for real clients, coordinating teams, organizing delivery flow, and driving strategic initiatives focused on efficient processes, collaboration, and consistent delivery.

42lux.title: Software Development Intern
42lux.description: Built, monitored, and tested a high-performance RPA system for public lighting operations. The solution automated critical workflows, removed bottlenecks, and improved productivity by roughly 100x while reducing manual errors.

cotabox.title: Software Engineer Intern
cotabox.description: Works on a real product used by multiple clients, building features and product improvements with Vue.js and GraphQL in a production environment.

foxtrot.title: Software Development Intern
foxtrot.description: Developed an e-commerce platform from scratch, covering database modeling, business logic, UI implementation, security, authentication, server maintenance, and internal tools with MySQL and PostgreSQL integrations.

ufba.title: BSc in Computer Engineering
ufba.description: Undergraduate studies focused on software engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application development.

anchieta.title: High School
anchieta.description: Completed secondary education before starting the Computer Engineering degree at UFBA.
